# partiteai_memory_store (Resource)

A memory store: what a mesh remembers, and the scopes that divide it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

- `consolidate_interval_seconds` (Number) How often the facts of this store are queued into consolidation passes
- `description` (String) Resource description
- `embedding_profile_id` (String) ID of the embedding profile this store writes its vectors with. A store without one is not embedded, and a recall over it searches words only. A store with any scope that extracts or consolidates needs one.
- `extract_interval_seconds` (Number) How often the turns of this store are planned into extraction work
- `index_conversation_messages` (Boolean) Index and embed those turns as well as keeping them, so a recall can find one by its words or its meaning
- `ingest_conversations` (Boolean) Write the turns of a conversation into this store as they are said
- `scopes` (Attributes List) The scopes of this store. A scope decides which documents are read and what tag the records it produces carry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))
- `user_name_tag_key` (String) The tag key whose value names whoever is not the agent. A store without one leaves those speakers unnamed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Required:

- `key` (String) The tag key that every record of this scope carries. It names the scope, and it never changes.
- `kind` (String) SLICED keeps a memory of each value of the tag it matches apart. UNSLICED makes one memory of everything it matches.

Optional:

- `consolidation_enabled` (Boolean) Fold the facts of this scope into observations
- `consolidation_model_profile_id` (String) ID of the model profile consolidation runs on. Required where consolidation_enabled is set.
- `consolidation_prompt` (String) Extra instructions for the consolidation call
- `description` (String) What this scope is for
- `extraction_enabled` (Boolean) Take facts out of the documents this scope reads
- `extraction_model_profile_id` (String) ID of the model profile extraction runs on. Required where extraction_enabled is set.
- `extraction_prompt` (String) Extra instructions for the extraction call
- `match` (String) The tag key that selects the documents this scope reads. A SLICED scope needs one. An UNSLICED scope without one reads every document.
- `value` (String) What an UNSLICED scope writes under that key. A SLICED scope takes each value from the document instead.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Scope identifier
